description: fetchngs downloads the FastQ files and, with --nf-core-pipeline rnaseq, writes samplesheet/samplesheet.csv for rnaseq (absolute FastQ paths; strandedness from --nf-core-rnaseq-strandedness, default auto). Runs whose ENA instrument_platform is not a short-read platform (the ones nf-core/mag accepts as short reads: ILLUMINA, BGISEQ, DNBSEQ, ELEMENT, ULTIMA, ION_TORRENT, LS454, …) are refused: rnaseq analyses short reads, and long-read, capillary or colour-space runs would be processed as if they were.
